svg.title: What the review costs (Proposition 8)
svg.desc: How often a review decides right, with half the designs better, and how many disagreements people must settle, as the design is split into 1, 2, 4 or 8 pieces; a 13-week quarter fits 52. The meeting: 75%, 65%, 50% and 50% right, with 4, 24, 134 and 758 disagreements. The Residual Protocol: 94%, 93%, 91% and 88% right, with at most 1.6.
svg.text: two people who hold the fact
134 disagreements, 82 more than a quarter holds
758 disagreements, 706 more than a quarter holds
Right: correct decisions, half the designs better. Box: one quarter, 52 disagreements.
